versions.changelog: Tool Showcase PPT by HTML 1.2.0 - Enhanced auto-layout workflow: fully automated page sequence, theme color, and background selection based on provided tool/app details. - Expanded layout and visual options: now supports 24 layouts, 17 dynamic backgrounds, and 9 theme color sets for customization. - Improved fallback mechanics: added automatic icon fallback for missing screenshots via onerror handling in tags. - Workflow and usage documentation greatly expanded, clarifying template copying, image replacement, and page arrangement for end users. - Theme color and background selection rules are now entirely automatic, with user override supported for theme colors. - Updated usage scenarios and clear recommendations on when to use or not use the skill.
